title: Gothic Witch with Sunflowers
description: A stylized gothic witch with pale skin, black hair, and steampunk goggles stands dynamically in a dark scene. She holds a large glowing purple crystal ball in one hand and a tall staff topped with a giant sunflower and purple flowers in the other.
prompt: A dynamic gothic witch with pale skin, black hair in an updo with white flowers, wearing steampunk purple goggles, a black and green corset top with purple skirt and tattered leggings, standing in a dark magical scene. She holds a glowing purple crystal ball on a vine-covered stone pedestal with one hand and a tall staff with a giant sunflower and purple flowers in the other. Dark background with floating potion bottles, sunflowers, ink splatters, and faint alchemical symbols, moody fantasy illustration style.
